defs.meaning: 校验；[电子][通信] 抑制；[涂料] 龟裂；检查；[力] 裂纹

examples.en: He and Lieutenant Cassidy were checking the scene of the crime.
examples.zh: 当时他正与卡西迪中尉一起检查犯罪现场。

examples.en: The police are checking out his alibi.
examples.zh: 警察在查证他不在案发现场的证据。

examples.en: My parents are always checking up on me.

synonyms.meaning: 校验；[电子][通信]抑制；[涂料]龟裂；检查；[力]裂纹
